author: originui
name: use-slider-with-input
description:
A React hook that manages the state and logic for a slider component with corresponding input fields. Provides validation, range constraints, and synchronized updates between slider and input values.

Features
- Synchronized slider and input field values
- Input validation and number formatting
- Range constraints for min/max values
- Support for single value or range (two handles)
- Reset functionality to default values
